info.name: Hotel Menara Hammamet API
info.description: Run the folders in order (right-click the collection > Run). Needs the Postman environment 'Hotel Menara - Local' with adminEmail and adminPassword filled in. All data is DEMO data; the test room is deleted at the end of folder 6.

exec: // Stay dates: 30 days from today, 3 nights (always in the future).

item.name: 0. System
item.description: Run first: checks that the API and the database are reachable.

item.name: 2. Authentication
item.description: Set adminEmail and adminPassword in the Postman environment first (administrator created with `npm run admin:create`).

item.name: Change password with wrong current password -> 401 (password unchanged)
3. Room management (admin)
item.description: Creates a temporary test room with ONE unit, used by the booking scenarios and deleted at the end.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "[DEMO] Postman test room",
  "slug": "{{testSlug}}",
  "type": "double",
  "description": "[DEMO] Temporary room created by the Postman collection.",
  "capacity": 2,
  "totalUnits": 1,
  "pricePerNight": 100,
  "amenities": [
    "[DEMO] Amenity"
  ],
  "images": [
    "https://example.com/demo/postman-room.jpg"
  ]
}

item.name: Create room with an unknown field -> 400 (mass assignment blocked)

body.raw:
{
  "name": "[DEMO] Bad room",
  "type": "double",
  "description": "[DEMO] Contains an unknown field",
  "capacity": 2,
  "totalUnits": 1,
  "pricePerNight": 100,
  "isDemo": true
}

item.name: 4. Availability and bookings
item.description: Dates are computed automatically (30 days from today, 3 nights). The test room has a single unit, so the second booking must fail.

item.name: Search availability with checkOut before checkIn -> 400

exec: pm.test("Price computed by the server", () => { const p = body.data.pricing; pm.expect(p.subtotal).to.eql(p.nightlyRate * p.nights); pm.expect(p.total).to.eql(+(p.subtotal + p.taxAmount + p.touristTax).toFixed(3)); });

item.name: Create booking with a client-supplied price -> 400
Create booking for the same dates -> 409 (double booking prevented)
Look up with the wrong e-mail -> 404
6. Administrator operations
item.description: Bookings, messages, settings, services, gallery, then cleanup of the test room.

item.name: Delete room with an upcoming booking -> 409
Search availability after cancellation (room free again)
7. Authorization failures
item.description: Every protected endpoint must refuse missing or invalid tokens.

item.name: Create gallery image with an invalid token -> 401
List contact messages with an invalid token -> 401
8. Optional AI assistant
item.description: Returns 503 AI_DISABLED when AI_ENABLED=false (default), 200 when enabled. Both are valid outcomes.

item.name: Ask the AI concierge with an empty message -> 400
